Business of Home is the leading business media brand for the home industry, delivering essential news, analysis and insights for interior designers and home furnishings professionals. Since launching in 2009, it has served as a trusted daily resource, with offerings that include a robust digital newsroom, newsletters, podcasts, a quarterly magazine, the industry’s largest job board, business workshops, and a membership community for the entrepreneurs, executives and creatives shaping the sector.
